task_name: Expose readiness and operational issue diagnostics

concerns_addressed: OperationalDiagnosticsTest covers admin-only access, disabled/kill-switch 503 gating, readiness schema, issue list/detail filters, severity mapping, and redaction without source mutation.
Routes are inside auth:api and apply the PrePilotGate middleware alias for disabled gating.

strengths: Diagnostics remain read-only and redaction-safe across readiness and issue surfaces.
Issue request validation enforces bounded filters and correlation_id constraint.
Feature gate and kill switch behavior are both covered by tests.
Kernel alias addition is minimal and routes wire is scoped to admin operations.
PrePilotControls setUp makes tests independent of ambient JWT env.
